note: Set A captures the sheet's key member section designations (W8X10, W10X12, PL5X3/8, L3X3X1/4, HSS 4X4X1/4), which Set B almost entirely omits despite their prominence in the details and reference keynotes. Set B instead repeats a few dimensions under several names (1 13/16", 1/4" TYP, PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2) and adds a height of 6' that appears nowhere on the page. Set A has one unsupported claim (a weld size quoted as '1/4" V', a quote not in the source) and some vague/duplicated dimension claims, but its coverage of real engineering facts is clearly stronger.
remarks: Both sets bind many bare dimension strings (1", 5/8", 5 1/8", 1 13/16") to generic entities like 'structural detail' or 'dimension', so the values are real but their engineering meaning is largely lost. Set B's 'duct framing | height | 6' ft' looks like a misread of 6" or 6 7/8". Neither set records the W10X15, C3X6 or L4X4X5/16 members, the 1'-3"/1'-4" overall dimensions with their detail assignments, or the detail-to-scale mapping (C1/C2/C4/A1/A3/A5 at 1 1/2" = 1'-0").
